name: security-requirements
description: Derives tailored security requirements for a service from NIST CSF 2.0, SP 800-53, OWASP ASVS, and cloud provider guidance. Prescriptive, not discovery: it says what the service must satisfy, before or independently of any code existing. Requires Python 3.12 or newer and PyYAML.

interface.shortDescription: Derive verifiable security requirements for a service
interface.longDescription: Build and maintain a tailored security requirements contract from architecture or repository evidence, NIST, OWASP ASVS, cloud responsibility guidance, threat modeling, and applicable regulatory overlays.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the security requirements profile for this repository.
Build security requirements from the confirmed profile.
Refresh security requirements after service changes.
Assess and review threat risk for this repository.
